data.action: 将棉花糖纸托放在身旁野餐桌上，腾出双手朝画面外的同行者比心。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, both heart-gesture hands and resting candy tray visible
data.description: 夏日游乐园的摩天轮下，海梦穿薄荷色轻外套、白T恤、宽松短截牛仔裤与粉色高帮帆布鞋，戴着小卡通发箍。她把吃了一半的彩虹棉花糖连同纸托放在身旁野餐桌上，再用两只手向你比心。近处桌边与彩色砖面清楚可见，围栏后摩天轮支架向高处延伸，更远处过山车轨道穿过夏云。左上阳光照亮渐变发梢、笑脸与棉花糖，围栏和桌脚各自在砖面留下斜影——「今天一整天都超级开心！接下来去坐过山车还是鬼屋？只要和你一起，去哪里我都超超超期待！」
data.lighting: bright summer sun from the upper left on hair and candy; distinct rail and table shadows on paving
data.location: 摩天轮下的游乐园休息角，野餐桌与围栏旁可见远处过山车
data.promptProse: Cotton candy rests in its folded paper tray on the picnic table beside Marin, leaving both of her hands free to form a heart toward the viewer. Her mint jacket opens over a white T-shirt, paired with loose cropped blue jeans and pink canvas high-tops; a small cartoon hairband sits above pink-tipped blonde hair. The near table edge and colored paving establish the park's resting corner. Beyond its railing, Ferris-wheel supports climb through the middle distance, with roller-coaster tracks curving farther back under summer clouds. Keep the complete hand gesture and the supported candy in an eye-level medium view. Clear sun from the upper left lights her laughing face, hair tips and the candy's colors. Rail bars and table legs cast separate diagonal shadows over the paving, connecting the foreground to the attractions.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 游乐园夏日
